why_math: Pre-computing system matrices works because separating geometric nonlinearity from material behavior via co-rotation allows the linear part to be factorized once; materials are nearly identical in near-rigid bodies, so this separation is mathematically justified and enables reuse across time steps.

Diffusion models denoise random noise toward learned realistic distributions step by step; adding spatio-temporal constraints guides the noise toward completions that satisfy the constraints while respecting the learned motion patterns, combining data likelihood with user intent.

The diffusion model learns the statistical relationship between lighting and appearance from training pairs; conditioning on lighting tokens tells it which appearance transformation to produce, while masked attention across frames enforces temporal consistency by making each frame prediction aware of its neighbors.

Feather structure is multi-scale and self-similar—coarse barbs contain finer barbules—so procedural encoding at each scale captures the hierarchy without storing every strand; correct shadowing and masking formulas then reconstruct the appearance from this compact model.

Motion viewed relative to moving anchors becomes simpler because anchors absorb the bulk motion; Gaussians then only track small residual deviations instead of long absolute trajectories, dramatically reducing the complexity each primitive must represent and improving stability.

The four-dimensional data naturally factors into three coupled pairs (XY-ZT, XZ-YT, YZ-XT), compressing it; neural networks refine this factorization efficiently, and iterative ray correction converges because each correction makes the forward model closer to the measured projections.

Randomizing particle positions along the time axis and using a 4D kernel turns temporal under-sampling into Monte Carlo noise; averaging many random time samples recovers the true integrated particle contribution, so noise shrinks predictably as sample density grows.

A Bayesian prior encodes that nearby BRDF measurements are correlated; the distance-based covariance kernel captures smoothness in material properties, so the posterior mean predicts unseen values accurately without overfitting, extracting maximum information from sparse samples.

If predicted material distributions produce the measured X-ray projections when rendered forward, they must recover the true materials; minimizing the projection loss drives the solution toward consistency, and gradient descent always moves downhill toward minimizers that satisfy this consistency.

Winding number equals ray intersections plus a boundary integral by an integral theorem; computing intersections directly (fast) and the collapsed spherical integral (small) avoids expensive surface integration while preserving the exact mathematical relationship, enabling both speed and precision.

Since stress depends globally on panel geometry, optimizing them jointly lets stress gradients guide shape toward both geometric faithfulness and structural strength; the flow formulation enables this coupling by differentiating through the stress analysis.

Embeddedness is a global topological property that shows up locally as mesh collisions; addressing both levels simultaneously prevents local fixes from creating new entanglements elsewhere, ensuring that all self-intersections resolve without cycling.

Octrees encode hierarchical refinement naturally—coarse nodes branch into fine children—so generating structure and geometry autoregressively at each scale respects the geometric hierarchy; this is much faster than diffusion because you build top-down rather than iteratively denoising.

Winding number theory robustly detects enclosed curves even in degenerate cases; the vector field's winding count wraps around small loops and tangent points topologically, pinpointing all starting points; subdivision then refines these points to high precision.

Splitting couples non-convex yarn constraints into independent convex sub-problems, each with a unique stable solution; theory-based metric selection ensures convergence without tuning, because convex minimizers are well-behaved and the split scheme provably reconstructs the coupled solution.
